recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast minimalist composition featuring a vibrant red background with stylized, oblique geometric shapes in primary and secondary colors, arranged to suggest a face or abstract initials.
coreVisualRelationships: A long, thin yellow diagonal bar acts as the central axis.
Three stacked blue parallelograms on the left balance a single green hollow square on the right.
A short horizontal tan bar sits at the bottom center to ground the composition.
All shapes share a consistent oblique shear or tilt.
coreInvariants: Sharp, clean edges on all geometric elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centralized geometric cluster occupying approximately 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The long yellow diagonal bar spanning from top-center to bottom-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes follow the yellow diagonal downward, then jump to the blue and green shapes flanking the upper half.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive red negative space surrounding the central motif, creating a sense of scale and focus.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep Blue and Teal Green (Flanking Elements)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all colors with medium-dark values for the blue and green to provide weight.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with varying tracking to maintain minimalist purity.

candidateDirections.reason: Geometric roots match the abstract shapes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid red canvas with a central geometric arrangement: a long yellow diagonal bar (top-right to bottom-left), three stacked blue parallelograms on the left, a teal-green hollow square on the right, and a small tan horizontal bar at the bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of small, uppercase, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif italic text centered along the top edge.

verificationChecks: Is the background a single solid red?
Are all shapes sharp-edged with no gradients?
Is the text small and widely spaced at the top?
Do the shapes follow a consistent oblique tilt?

adjustableVariables: Tracking width of the top text
mustRedesign: Any specific band names or album titles
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is perfectly centered and horizontal.
Check that the yellow bar is the longest element.
Verify the teal square has a smaller red square cutout in its center.
Check for consistent oblique angles across all shapes.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid background + central oblique geometric cluster + top-aligned minimalist metadata text.
